title: PFCP: add new Nokia IE dissectors
description:
Adding IE dissectors for following Nokia IEs:

- CP Function Features
- Content Filtering Policy ID
- Dropped volume Measurement
- Health Report Interval

Or not, you are correct :) when NULL length there is no call on dissector_try_uint_with_data, hence when when actually called there should be some data/length

Joakim is correct: the "to be removed" codepath hits before the call to the custom dissector happens. Temporarily removing this code, I do hit a dissector error when returning 0 from the IE-dissector.

This IE wasn't in the pcap I tested with and didn't cause problems before in my local branch, as this still uses a different method to call the IE-dissectors.

I will remove this IE dissector to unblock this MR.
